request: Quiero tres propuestas visuales con la paleta actual para preparar la consulta y el portal, antes de cerrar lo funcional.

candidates.thesis: A longitudinal rail connects the last contact, current signals and next consultation as one clinical story.
candidates.visibleDifference: Time organizes the surface and the active decision expands beside the rail.
candidates.opportunity: Show why the next decision follows from recent evidence without adding prose.
candidates.risk: Chronology may outrank urgent safety facts unless the active state is forceful.

candidates.thesis: The screen reads like a clinical safety docket whose first scan is risk, medication and next action.
candidates.visibleDifference: A compact vertical index anchors an ordered evidence sheet with safety facts pinned at the top.
candidates.opportunity: Make professional rigor expressive through alignment and restraint instead of ornament.
candidates.risk: The docket can feel bureaucratic if the patient identity becomes too quiet.

candidates.thesis: The surface prepares the next conversation by pairing what the professional must know with what the patient must do.
candidates.visibleDifference: Two unequal columns share one handoff line while clinician evidence and patient action keep distinct navigation.
candidates.opportunity: Give dashboard and portal a related grammar without confusing their perspectives.
candidates.risk: The paired metaphor can imply simultaneous use when the real products are separate.

claimBoundary: This receipt demonstrates selection, loading and procedural influence of corrected skills and Impeccable. The three high-fidelity pilot arms remain a separate observational comparison.
